files.body:
### Added

- internal restructuring of Vue and PHP source code, there is now a
  common base of code shared between the
  [PDF Downloader](https://github.com/rotdrop/nextcloud-app-pdf-downloader)
  and this app.

## Fixed

- fix mime-type injection code
